Northwind Analytics builds scheduling and analytics software for mid-sized logistics companies. We are a 180-person team that has grown 40% a year for three years.

The role
You will work with a senior product manager on our route-planning product. You will talk to customers every week, turn what you learn into clear requirements, and work with engineers and designers to ship improvements every two weeks.

What you will do
- Interview customers and analyse support tickets to find the problems worth solving
- Write user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep the backlog prioritised
- Track product metrics (adoption, retention, time-to-plan) and report on them monthly
- Run small experiments and present the results to leadership
- Coordinate releases with sales and customer success

What we are looking for
- Bachelor's degree in business, information systems or a related field (new graduates welcome)
- Strong written communication; you can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical customer
- Comfort with data: spreadsheets required, SQL a plus
- Evidence of leading a project or team, for example in a student club, internship or part-time job
- Curiosity about logistics and supply chains

Nice to have
- Experience with Jira or a similar tool
- Exposure to agile or scrum
- A product, consulting or analytics internship

Salary range: $68,000–$78,000 plus bonus. Apply by November 15.
